scope: One explicit rational planar 11-point seven-pool witness; no general bound or external audit.

definitions.path: Increasing vertex sequence; each consecutive triple has its color; length counts vertices; 2-point paths both colors.
definitions.weak7: Same outer endpoints, R and B lengths sum to 9; no disjointness assumption imposed.
definitions.hitting: Minimum vertex set meeting every listed edge; complete subsets are enumerated.
